mapper.select: select u.id as user_id, #{date} as snapshot_date, coalesce(datediff(#{date}, a.latest_order), 9999) as rfm_recency_days, coalesce(a.frequency, 0) as rfm_frequency_30d, coalesce(a.monetary, 0) as rfm_monetary_30d, coalesce(round(cast(a.lunch as decimal(20,6)) / nullif(a.frequency, 0), 6), 0) as order_lunch_ratio, coalesce(round(cast(a.dinner as decimal(20,6)) / nullif(a.frequency, 0), 6), 0) as order_dinner_ratio, coalesce(round(cast(a.night as decimal(20,6)) / nullif(a.frequency, 0), 6), 0) as order_night_ratio, coalesce(round(cast(p.low_qty as decimal(20,6)) / nullif(p.total, 0), 6), 0) as price_low_ratio, coalesce(round(cast(p.mid_qty as decimal(20,6)) / nullif(p.total, 0), 6), 0) as price_mid_ratio, coalesce(round(cast(p.high_qty as decimal(20,6)) / nullif(p.total, 0), 6), 0) as price_high_ratio, (select d.category_id from orders o join order_detail od on od.order_id=o.id join dish d on d.id=od.dish_id where and o.user_id=u.id and d.category_id is not null group by d.category_id order by sum(greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1)) desc limit 1) as category_pref_top1, (select d.category_id from orders o join order_detail od on od.order_id=o.id join dish d on d.id=od.dish_id where and o.user_id=u.id and d.category_id is not null group by d.category_id order by sum(greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1)) desc limit 1 offset 1) as category_pref_top2 from user u left join ( select o.user_id, count(*) as frequency, sum(coalesce(o.amount,0)) as monetary, max(o.order_time) as latest_order, sum(time(o.order_time) >= '10:00:00' and time(o.order_time) < '15:00:00') as lunch, sum(time(o.order_time) >= '17:00:00' and time(o.order_time) < '22:00:00') as dinner, sum(not ((time(o.order_time) >= '10:00:00' and time(o.order_time) < '15:00:00') or (time(o.order_time) >= '17:00:00' and time(o.order_time) < '22:00:00'))) as night from orders o where and exists(select 1 from order_detail od join dish d on d.id=od.dish_id where od.order_id=o.id) group by o.user_id ) a on a.user_id=u.id left join ( select o.user_id, sum(greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1)) as total, sum(if(coalesce(d.price,0) <= #{low}, greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1),0)) as low_qty, sum(if(coalesce(d.price,0) > #{low} and coalesce(d.price,0) <= #{mid}, greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1),0)) as mid_qty, sum(if(coalesce(d.price,0) > #{mid}, greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1),0)) as high_qty from orders o join order_detail od on od.order_id=o.id join dish d on d.id=od.dish_id where group by o.user_id ) p on p.user_id=u.id order by u.id

select d.id as dish_id, d.category_id, coalesce(d.price,0) as price, #{date} as snapshot_date, coalesce(s.qty1,0) as sales_qty_1d, coalesce(s.qty7,0) as sales_qty_7d, coalesce(s.qty30,0) as sales_qty_30d, coalesce(s.decay,0) as decay_sales_30d from dish d left join ( select od.dish_id, sum(if(o.order_time >= #{oneDay}, greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1),0)) as qty1, sum(if(o.order_time >= #{sevenDays}, greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1),0)) as qty7, sum(greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1)) as qty30, sum(greatest(coalesce(od.number,1),1) * exp(-#{lambda} * datediff(#{date}, o.order_time))) as decay from orders o join order_detail od on od.order_id=o.id where group by od.dish_id ) s on s.dish_id=d.id order by d.id
